dogecoin.text: In ClownWorld, the punchlines are the prices. $DOGE is selling low because it can't buy a dime at the dollar store price of $1.00.
Scientists discover common sense is officially extinct - last specimen found in a basement playing with Dogecoin and tinfoil hats.

Just when I thought this crypto circus couldn't get any wackier, Solana's SOL jumps 10% in an hour while Dogecoin gets rekt. I guess what's old is new again - who needs actual value when you've got meme power!
